title: HomeworkDocument
description: course/assessments/homework-document.yaml — how the homework Word documents look (homework module, HW-D30). The agent fills the student and teacher documents from this file plus the approved manifest and items at /create-homework step 12. Optional: created by the first /create-homework (HW-D13). Holds no answers, so it is committed like any course file.

course_title.description: Course name as printed on the documents.

instructor.description: Instructor name(s) as printed on the documents.

semester.description: Current offering, e.g. 'Spring 2027' or 'Semester B, 2026-27'. Update it each semester.

title_format.description: Document title. Placeholders: {course_title}, {semester}, {number} (homework number from the id: HW03 -> 3), {id}, {units}.

due_date_format.description: How the due date is printed, e.g. 'DD/MM/YYYY'. The date itself is the manifest's `due_date`.

submission_instructions.description: Printed on the student document, e.g. 'Submit one PDF on Moodle'.

header.description: Free text for the page header.

footer.description: Free text for the page footer.

logo.description: Optional path, relative to course/, of an image printed in the header.

language.description: Document language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'he', 'en'.

show_est_minutes.description: Print each item's estimated minutes on the student document.
